item.title: Iran accuses U.S. of war crime after strike allegedly kills at least 4 at wedding
item.description: Iran accused the United States of war crimes on Wednesday over a strike that they say killed multiple civilians at a wedding party near the Strait of Hormuz. CBS News' Weijia Jiang reports.

item.title: The mood inside court as Lindsay Clancy judge implores jury to keep deliberating
item.description: The judge in Lindsay Clancy's triple murder trial could issue a mistrial as the jury remains deadlocked on Day 5 of deliberations. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul reports and legal contributor Jessica Levinson offers analysis.

item.title: Police respond to downtown Minneapolis shooting that injured 2 officers, others
item.description: Dozens of police squads are on the scene of a shooting that injured several people, including two police officers, near the Minneapolis Convention Center late Wednesday afternoon.

item.title: 8 Democrats break rank and vote for anti-socialism bill
item.description: Two House Democrats are in hot water with leadership for failing to say that they would vote with Republicans on an anti-socialism bill. Political strategists Kevin Sheridan and Hyma Moore join "The Takeout" to discuss what the situation says about Democrats' divisions.

item.title: OpenAI facing new lawsuits over deadly Canada school shooting
item.description: More lawsuits have been filed against OpenAI in connection with February's deadly mass school shooting in Canada that took the lives of five students and a teacher. CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson breaks down the case.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy jury deadlocked, ends day without verdict
item.description: The jury in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial, which signaled Wednesday for a second straight day it is deadlocked, left without a verdict and will resume deliberations on Thursday.

item.title: Ross Fire still burning after a week, with over 90,000 acres scorched
item.description: The wildfire, which has torn through Palo Pinto and Jack counties, has forced evacuations, closed roads and disrupted schools.

item.title: Uber to shed 10% of workers as it moves to cut costs and streamline
item.description: CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said Uber is removing organizational layers and taking other steps to boost its efficiency.

item.title: Democratic Rep. Tom Suozzi calls on party to reject DSA
item.description: As progressive and moderate Democrats debate the party's path forward, Rep. Tom Suozzi of New York is calling on fellow Democrats to reject the Democratic Socialists of America. Suozzi joins "The Takeout" to discuss his piece in The Free Press, a Paramount publication.

item.title: Gina Hinojosa calls Abbott's Texas data center pause "an attempt to protect his reelection chances"
item.description: The nationwide political debate over data centers has made its way into the Texas governor's race. Gov. Greg Abbott recently paused approvals for new data centers, but his Democratic opponent, State Rep. Gina Hinojosa, says she's skeptical he'll stick to it. Hinojosa joins "The Takeout" to discuss her campaign.

item.title: Iran attacks U.S. allies in Gulf region as Trump downplays peace deal potential
item.description: President Trump on Wednesday downplayed the importance of a peace deal with Tehran while calling on Iranian citizens to take over their government. CBS News' Weijia Jiang and Samantha Vinograd have the latest.

item.title: OpenAI confirms "critical" risks of Astra model, despite plans to release it soon
item.description: OpenAI confirmed that its unreleased Astra model has reached a critical cyber capability threshold, which could pose cybersecurity risks. Tim Werth, a tech editor at Mashable, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Judge gives "dynamite instruction" to deadlocked Lindsay Clancy jury
item.description: For the second day in a row, the jury in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial reported that they were unable to reach a unanimous verdict. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul and Caroline Polisi have the details.

item.title: Plane carrying Mullin makes emergency landing after engine failure
item.description: "The United States Coast Guard pilots made the single engine landing feel routine. No panic, just straight professionalism," Mullin said on X.

item.title: Sneak peek: Tracker Dakota Black
item.description: ENCORE: A detective hunts for answers when a woman goes missing. For Tracker Black it's personal. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports Saturday, Sept. 5 at 10/9c on CBS and streaming on Paramount+.

item.title: Dark money in Texas Senate race spurs Talarico complaint to FEC against Paxton
item.description: James Talarico's Senate campaign is accusing Ken Paxton and his campaign treasurer of "illegally spending" $1 million that was routed to a Paxton-aligned super PAC.

item.title: Trump suggests changing Strait of Hormuz name to "Trump Strait"
item.description: On Wednesday, President Trump posted on Truth Social, "Now that we have it under U.S.A. control, should we change the name Hormuz Strait to TRUMP STRAIT???" CBS News White House reporter Olivia Rinaldi has more.

item.title: 20-year-old Haitian man dies by apparent suicide after losing TPS
item.description: Pierre Damas Bel, a 20-year-old Haitian immigrant, died by apparent suicide in Ohio after losing his temporary protected status. Dr. Carl Ruby, a senior pastor in the community, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Accused leader of Penn State drug ring granted bail
item.description: The former Penn State student accused of leading a cocaine trafficking ring at the university was granted bail on Wednesday. CBS News correspondent Lana Zak has the details.

item.title: MapQuest hits No. 1 on App Store after refusing to rename Lake Ontario
item.description: MapQuest topped ChatGPT as Apple's most-downloaded free app after the digital mapping company said it would keep "historical, familiar" lake names.

item.title: People turning to BNPL loans to pay for rent, food and other necessities
item.description: More consumers are taking out "buy now, pay later" loans to make ends meet, a sign of the U.S. affordability crisis, according to consumer advocates.

item.title: Inside a New Jersey town that lost several residents to 9/11 terror | 60 Minutes Archive
item.description: Just days after the 9/11 attacks, 60 Minutes correspondent Ed Bradley visited a NJ town where many who worked in or near the Twin Towers were still missing, and met a family desperately searching for their husband and brother.

item.title: House rejects GOP effort to ban Supreme Court expansion in Constitution
item.description: A GOP-proposed constitutional amendment to limit the Supreme Court to nine justices failed in the House, coming up well short of the two-thirds majority needed.

item.title: Clippers, Leonard penalized by NBA for alleged violation of salary cap rules
item.description: The Clippers will forfeit five future first-round draft picks, while Leonard must pay the league $700,000.

item.title: $1 gold Trump coins are on sale, but they'll cost you more than $1 apiece
item.description: The U.S. Mint said the President Donald J. Trump $1 coin can be bought in packages of 25 for $61 or 100 coins for $154.50.

item.title: Family blames suicide of 20-year-old Haitian immigrant on ICE crackdown
item.description: A 20-year-old Haitian native died by suicide in Ohio this week, his family says, a death his father said was driven in part by feelings of despair and humiliation after ICE fitted him with an ankle monitor.

item.title: Meta says AI glasses fix stops users from secretly recording others
item.description: Meta upgrades its AI glasses' privacy features to block device users from filming people without their consent.

item.title: House votes to condemn socialism, with 8 Democrats joining Republicans
item.description: GOP leaders scheduled the vote after Democratic primary voters embraced a number of democratic socialist candidates.

item.title: Whistleblower warns Postal Service's mail ballot portal is "rushed," "untested"
item.description: The whistleblower, described by lawyers as a federal official, disclosed information about the Postal Service's new mail-voting procedures to Democratic Sen. Richard Blumenthal of Connecticut.

item.title: Southern California city deploys drone to track down lost pets
item.description: California is using a $17,000 drone to quickly track down and rescue lost pets by detecting animal heat. Carter Evans reports.
